Socket.IO is part of 5 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2018.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2), [Web](@/projects/web.md) (2) and [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [bc-apple](@/work/bc-apple.md): BlockCollider Apple Apps; [lethe.it](@/work/lethe-it.md): lethe.it - your personal smart links archive, organizer, classifier and much more; [microscratch](@/work/microscratch.md): Light Weight Web Framework using node.js, mongo, sockets, ember.js.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Socket.IO: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Socket.IO to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
